title: Request: Trial credits & extension for Databridge PoC — dataplane migration delay
text:
Request: Trial credits & extension for Databridge PoC — dataplane migration delay

['From: Samira Khan <sk@databridgelabs.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: PoC hold — dataplane migration causing delay (trial extension request)

Hi Nikhil,

Quick note from our side — during the environment cutover this morning our dataplane migration hit a blocker related to the connector schema mismatch. The engineering team estimates ~2–3 weeks to fix, validate, and re-run our end-to-end tests. That pushes our demo and load window out of the current sandbox expiration.

We’re still committed to the PoC but need two things to avoid losing momentum: a 30-day extension of the trial sandbox window and an additional sandbox credit top-up (~$4k–$5k worth of tokens/instances) so we can spin a temporary dev cluster while the migration completes.

I attached the migration timeline and an error screenshot for context. Can Redwood help here? If so we’ll update the MAP and aim for a new demo week the first week of July.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
VP Engineering, DataBridge Labs
ops@databridgelabs.com
Attachment: dataplane-migration-timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: error-screenshot.png (image)', 'From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <sk@databridgelabs.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PoC hold — dataplane migration causing delay (trial extension request)

Samira —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching the timeline + screenshot. Sorry to hear you hit this during cutover. I’ve looped in Dev (solutions) and Monica (your AE) so we can scope the ask fast. A couple quick questions to help triage on our side:

- Do you have an estimate of the peak token / instance usage we should provision for the temporary dev cluster? (rough CPU/GPU and daily token volume)
- Is the migration impact limited to one connector or is it broad across multiple pipelines?

We can escalate a one-time sandbox credit adjustment and a 30-day extension to promotions, but I’ll need the environment snapshot and the updated MAP with milestones to justify the credit amount. If you can share the CSV of environment sizes (or confirm numbers inline) we’ll push this through and reply with a concrete offer today.

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment requested: environment-snapshot.csv
', 'From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <sk@databridgelabs.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PoC hold — dataplane migration causing delay (trial extension request)

Hi Samira — thanks for the files. A couple notes from the infra perspective:

- The screenshot points to a schema mismatch on the ingestion layer; if it’s isolated to one connector we can recommend a temporary parallel ingestion route to bypass the blocker and keep your demo data flowing.
- For a temp dev cluster to mirror your PoC throughput I’d estimate 2x the current token budget for 10 days, or 1.5x for a rolling 30 day window (we need your daily average to be precise).

If you’re fine with an interim approach we can offer a provisional credit of 30k tokens (equivalent ~$3.5k) to spin the dev cluster while Redwood Promotions reviews the full top-up. We’ll need the CSV environment snapshot and a one-paragraph description of the migration plan to open the approval.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Samira: drop the environment-snapshot.csv (or paste sizes) + short migration plan (1–3 bullets)
- We: provision provisional credit and create a short-term route to keep your ingestion alive

Onward — Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
', 'From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <sk@databridgelabs.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PoC hold — dataplane migration causing delay (trial extension request)

Samira,

Appreciate the quick updates. Monica here — I own your account. We can greenlight a 30-day extension for the sandbox and provision a promotional top-up. Based on Dev’s recommendation I’m proposing a $4,000 provisional credit while Promotions finalizes the full amount (we’ll convert to token units once approved). To move forward I need: the environment-snapshot.csv and the short migration plan.

If you send those by EOD today I’ll route the approval and confirm the provisional credit by tomorrow afternoon. Also please confirm the new target demo week (you mentioned first week of July).

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | monica_patel@redwood.com
', 'From: Samira Khan <sk@databridgelabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 17:34:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PoC hold — dataplane migration causing delay (trial extension request)

Thanks team — attaching the environment snapshot and a short migration plan. We confirm the demo target is July 5–8 (first week window). The migration affects two connectors (payments + events) but the ingestion shim should let us bypass payments for the demo; events will be the critical path.

Migration plan (brief):
- Day 0–3: patch schema mapping and add lightweight transformation layer (engineering)
- Day 4–8: smoke tests on staging + end-to-end validation
- Day 9–12: enable parallel ingestion route and cutover

We accept the provisional $4k credit and 30-day extension — appreciate the fast help. I’ve attached the files.

Best,
Samira
Attachment: environment-snapshot.csv (csv)
Attachment: dataplane-migration-timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)
']
